capabilities: fetch pending artifact deliveries for the vault
extras: Documents its network calls in detail and states that no vault contents are sent; only the API key and vault name leave the device. Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Voice messages recorded and transcribed outside Obsidian have no built-in way to arrive in the vault as notes.

relations.evidence: Sync voice-note artifacts from Dictava into Obsidian vault.
Dictava turns voice messages you send to @DictavaBot Telegram bot into structured artifacts

summary: Syncs artifacts that the Dictava service generates from Telegram voice messages into the vault via its API.
